selected_candidates.title: Reactive-power and contracted-capacity leakage auditor
selected_candidates.selection_case: The facility already pays a monthly bill, its owner can authorize tariff or equipment changes, and contingency pricing can tie the new fee to verified savings rather than regulation. Accountants, electricians and the family installer provide plausible lists and channels. Customer-permissioned invoices, interval data and labeled interventions could compound into a non-prompt cross-DSO savings asset.
selected_candidates.primary_limiter: DECISIVE GAP: the prevalence and size of recoverable leakage after acquisition, electrician cost and defensible measurement are unknown; vendors often audit free to sell hardware.
decisive_research_questions: What share and distribution of 100 unrelated SME bills contains conservatively recoverable annual value, and who has authority to sign a contingency contract?
Can a named accountant, electrician or installer channel produce a permissioned reachable list and signed paid cases without founder-heavy selling?
Can interval-data access and a pre-agreed baseline attribute savings despite weather, occupancy and production changes?
What are contribution margin, cash timing, support hours and the bottom-up customer count needed for the founder wealth path?
What do brokers and equipment vendors already include free, and what data and outcome-reuse rights survive customer confidentiality?
selected_candidates.founder_fit_assessment: Excellent quantitative and family-channel fit, low initial capital and part-time-testable; certified field work can stay with partners, but baseline review and support hours must remain within five hours per day.
selected_candidates.structure_family: outcome-priced energy-cost recovery with partner-delivered remediation

selected_candidates.title: Cross-processor chargeback evidence autopilot for CEE merchants
selected_candidates.selection_case: Processor fees and disputed cash make the loss observable, merchants control evidence and submission approval, and success pricing aligns payment with a won dispute. Agency and commerce-platform channels are enumerable. Cross-processor integrations plus outcome-labeled evidence and prevention patterns are a non-prompt asset, but only if the product beats processor-native tools.
selected_candidates.primary_limiter: DECISIVE GAP: no accessible CEE merchant niche yet shows enough dispute volume or incremental win-rate and labor uplift over Stripe-like native automation.
decisive_research_questions: Which vertical and processor mix yields a reachable list of merchants with enough disputes and an authorized risk or finance buyer?
In blinded historical and prospective cases, what incremental wins and labor savings occur versus each merchant's native tool and normal process?
Which processors permit evidence retrieval, submission and retention, and may outcome data be reused in privacy-safe models?
What are manual-review cost, dispute-value distribution, payout delay, agency share and conservative customer count for the founder target?
Can one agency or app channel contractually distribute the product, and why will processors or fraud suites not bundle the wedge?
selected_candidates.founder_fit_assessment: Strong data-integration and automation fit with low capital and global upside; weak proprietary domain access and deadline-driven integration support are the main fit costs.
selected_candidates.structure_family: contingency-priced dispute recovery and prevention SaaS

selected_candidates.title: Vendor-Neutral EV Charger Reliability Operations
selected_candidates.selection_case: Public status feeds can expose named outage-led prospects, fleet owners control backend access and SLA spend, and per-connector fees create recurring revenue. Installer handover is an event-driven channel. Backend integrations, remedy playbooks, technician density and first-time-fix performance form a non-prompt operating asset rather than a report.
selected_candidates.primary_limiter: DECISIVE GAP: AFIR data do not prove a separate uptime budget, and closed backends plus field dispatch may make positive margins or part-time operation impossible.
decisive_research_questions: How accurate are public outages, who owns the affected 20-500 connector fleets, and which named role can buy an external SLA?
What monitoring and repair spend already exists, and will a fleet pay for a 50-connector pilot rather than rely on its CPO, OEM or installer?
What OCPP, warranty, payment-provider and remote-action rights can customers actually grant across target brands?
What remote-close, one-visit-close, travel, parts, on-call and technician-density economics support a conservative wealth path?
Can a business-hours service remain credible while the founder is employed, and what operational layer must be hired or partnered?
selected_candidates.founder_fit_assessment: Good renewable, anomaly-detection and automation fit with a capital-light contracted-field pilot; continuous escalation is a serious mismatch unless scope and staffing are bounded.
selected_candidates.structure_family: per-connector managed reliability operations with field-service coordination

selected_candidates.title: OZE curtailment compensation and deadline recovery service
selected_candidates.selection_case: Executed curtailment creates a measurable cash entitlement and deadline; the asset owner controls the claim and telemetry, while contingency pricing charges only on incremental recovery. O&M firms, lenders and insurers can identify relevant assets. Permissioned dispatch, weather, settlement and recovery outcomes could compound beyond prompt-generated claim packs.
selected_candidates.primary_limiter: DECISIVE GAP: a compensation right is not a service budget; the frequency and value of under-recovery among accessible independent plants may be too small or already handled by professional managers.
decisive_research_questions: How many independently owned eligible plants and events are reachable through named O&M or finance partners, and who controls claim authority?
Across historical settled events, how often is valid cash late, missed or under-calculated, and what incremental value is recoverable?
Can owners lawfully provide telemetry, dispatch and settlement records, and may derived outcome models be reused?
What legal-expert cost, collection delay, success-fee margin and event frequency support the founder wealth path?
Will one O&M, lender or insurer route live cases, and what prevents its own asset-management software or adviser from internalizing the workflow?
selected_candidates.founder_fit_assessment: Excellent renewable and quantitative fit with low capital and outcome pricing; it can stay part-time only if data intake is standardized and disputes are handed to a specialist.
selected_candidates.structure_family: contingency-priced claims recovery and deadline monitoring

selected_candidates.title: KSeF-connected late-payment early warning and recovery workflow
selected_candidates.selection_case: Suppliers already experience recurring overdue cash and control reminders and escalation. Monthly plus outcome pricing can be tied to realized collections rather than to KSeF compliance. Accounting, factoring and insurance channels can aggregate buyers, while permissioned intervention-and-recovery outcomes could become a non-prompt prioritization asset.
selected_candidates.primary_limiter: DECISIVE GAP: incremental recovery over disciplined ordinary reminders is unproved, attribution is difficult, and bank, invoice and debtor data rights may block both delivery and compounding.
decisive_research_questions: Which Polish SME segment yields a reachable list with sufficient invoice volume, overdue exposure and an authorized finance buyer?
In a randomized human-approved test, what incremental cash and DSO improvement occur without more disputes, complaints or damaged relationships?
What KSeF, accounting and bank permissions are lawful and acceptable, and which cross-customer features cannot be pooled?
What success-fee attribution rule, human escalation load, insolvency mix and collection delay produce sustainable contribution margin?
Can an accounting, factoring or insurer partner distribute it, and why will existing accounting or collections systems not bundle the workflow?
selected_candidates.founder_fit_assessment: Strong finance, modeling and automation fit with low capital and asynchronous delivery; security, sensitive-data governance and collections escalation add material burden.
selected_candidates.structure_family: outcome-priced receivables workflow with escalation routing

selected_candidates.title: Data-Act Maintenance Gateway for Mixed-Brand Factory Equipment
selected_candidates.selection_case: This is a material mechanism change from the historical Data Act machine-data desk: it moves from one-off savings memos to live fault intake, paid telemetry and repair workflow, with plants or service firms paying around actual callouts. A service firm can bring an installed base, and machine-class connectors plus verified repair outcomes can compound beyond reports. The change plausibly addresses the old memo-only weakness but not the old access gate.
selected_candidates.primary_limiter: DECISIVE GAP: no selected machine class has yet shown timely, reusable owner-authorized data or paid reductions in truck rolls; OEM restrictions can collapse the model into bespoke integration.
decisive_research_questions: Which one non-safety-critical machine class has costly repeat faults, repeatable schemas and independent service firms with named customer lists?
For ten owner-authorized assets, how quickly and completely do OEMs provide usable data, and what trade-secret, warranty or reuse limits apply?
Do five live fault packets reduce visits, diagnosis time, downtime or wrong parts enough for three paid cases and recurring contracts?
What connector development, security, expert support and per-asset economics support the founder target without custom-project creep?
Can independently recruited partners avoid employer conflict, and why will OEM portals, CMMS or predictive-maintenance incumbents not substitute?
selected_candidates.founder_fit_assessment: Exceptional data-engineering and FMCG-operations fit and feasible on one class part-time; employer-conflict separation and strict control of connector scope are mandatory.
selected_candidates.structure_family: authorized machine-data gateway embedded in independent maintenance

selected_candidates.title: Inspection operating system and dispatch network for property managers
selected_candidates.selection_case: Qualified inspections are an observable existing purchase and the property owner or manager controls procurement. A per-building fee plus dispatch margin attaches to the paid event rather than merely selling reminders. Property-manager and inspector lists are reachable; route density, inspector reliability, defect and remediation outcomes form a non-prompt operating asset.
selected_candidates.primary_limiter: DECISIVE GAP: mandatory inspection spend does not prove managers will route procurement through a new operator, and low event frequency, travel and c-KOB incumbency may erase margin.
decisive_research_questions: Which private-manager segment yields at least 200 reachable buildings, what inspection events recur annually, and who can mandate routing?
What does each building already spend across inspection, protocol correction and remediation, and will managers sign a paid routing renewal?
What inspector supply, qualification, travel, insurance, rework and payment terms determine contribution margin and operating hours?
What c-KOB and property-system access is available, who owns protocol data, and may anonymized defect outcomes be reused?
How does the offer beat c-KOB, facilities firms and management software, and what building count supports the founder wealth path?
selected_candidates.founder_fit_assessment: Strong automation and family-electrical adjacency with a practical local pilot; dispatch and quality control are operationally heavier than the founder prefers and require partner ownership.
selected_candidates.structure_family: regulated inspection marketplace and compliance operating system

selected_candidates.title: Occupational-medicine booking and eligibility orchestration for SMEs
selected_candidates.selection_case: Employers already pay for each required examination and control referrals and booking, creating a repeated transaction rather than only a compliance document. Staffing, payroll and clinic channels are enumerable. Contracted appointment inventory plus privacy-minimized lead-time, no-show and referral-defect data could become a non-prompt routing asset.
selected_candidates.primary_limiter: DECISIVE GAP: mandatory examination spend does not prove an intermediary margin; incumbent clinic groups and direct employer relationships may leave no usable inventory or switching benefit.
decisive_research_questions: Which employer segment has enough annual exams, paid downtime, booking delay and referral errors, and who has authority to change providers?
Will three independent clinics expose appointment inventory and pay or share margin on 200 completed exams?
What per-exam revenue survives no-shows, rescheduling, support and clinic payments, and what volume supports the founder target?
What minimum employment and health data are required, who may access them, and can routing outcomes be reused lawfully?
What measurable service advantage causes repeat orders versus national occupational-health providers or direct local contracts?
selected_candidates.founder_fit_assessment: Good health, data and workflow fit with a low-capital concierge test and no public persona; sensitive-data security and appointment operations are material costs, and the nearby medical perspective is not distribution authority.
selected_candidates.structure_family: per-exam healthcare operations marketplace and eligibility workflow

alternates.reason: Urgent post-failure PV rescue is a material change from the historical pre-sale BatteryFit pack and is easy to pilot through family access, but consumer ticket size, paid acquisition, telemetry access and a white-label portfolio buyer remain decisive gaps.

Attaching BDO evidence to an actual waste pickup creates a transaction and local data asset, but exemptions, collector-bundled paperwork, thin take-rate economics and manual booking burden need proof.

Converter quote and artwork approval can be a real PPWR change-control gate with strong founder fit, but near-term brand budget, converter attachment, data rights, liability and employer-conflict separation are unproved.

Per-serial QA integration and repeatable grading could create a genuine battery rail, but upstream OEM bundling, supplier and BMS access, downstream acceptance, safety liability and the addressable CEE operator count are unresolved.

e-TOLL is a repeated cash flow with partner distribution and anomaly data potential, but billing/API access, verified recoverable value and differentiation from EETS and telematics providers are not established.

rejected_candidates.reason: BatteryFit-adjacent installer channel remains dependent on fragmented device APIs; low dynamic-tariff adoption, net savings, customer payment and support economics are unproved.
Public DSO capacity is not predictive or reservable, so the offer remains a copyable report without paid decision-use or bottom-up economics.
Free official operators and existing auditors own trust; no separate QA budget, defect rate or non-prompt control point is evidenced.
This is a weaker generic cousin of historical GreenTender: open alerts are easy to copy and no bid outcome, scarce evidence graph or paid use is shown.
Free KSeF tools and ERP vendors can bundle the monitor; exception frequency, read access, price and reusable advantage are absent.
Supplier packaging weights still require bespoke onboarding, advisers can bundle filing, and cross-customer mapping rights and wealth-scale economics are unknown.
It repeats the historical CBAM broker-and-supplier-data gate without contracted document flow, a reachable above-threshold denominator or a mechanism resolving broker bundling.
Changing the DORA payer to the regulated entity does not resolve incumbent GRC trust, sensitive-contract procurement, local deployment burden or a separate recurring budget.
Public-surface checks are easy for platforms and generic governance scanners to bundle; legal scope, paid budget and a non-prompt asset are weak.
Free EUDAMED tooling and regulatory consultants own the workflow; addressable batch volume, third-party access, maintenance spend and defensibility are missing.
Public CTIS data omit enrollment performance and budget, leaving a research pack that CROs with private feasibility systems can route around.
Excellent founder fit does not overcome free BIDS tools, niche academic budgets, bespoke QC and an unsupported path from dataset services to wealth-scale equity.
DSO authority and hidden grid constraints limit prediction; licensed-engineer redesign is bespoke, partner distribution is asserted and project cycles are long.
Contractors can bundle transition advice and field work; deferred restrictions, technician dependence, liability and high-touch multi-site delivery obscure a separate profitable budget.
Free one-stop support, association voting, licensed design and construction coordination create long, meeting-heavy cycles incompatible with part-time validation.
The discovery evidence itself says present PV recycling is low-volume, high-cost and low-revenue; route density, payer control, permits and resale economics are not close enough.
The more operational CBAM framing still preserves the historical broker gate, supplier-data access and verifier dependence without a contracted intake trigger or viable labor economics.
The first-operator market has shrunk after simplification, deadlines moved, established traceability platforms exist and geospatial or legality judgments add substantial liability.
OEM contracts and clinic systems can bundle schedules; small-clinic budgets, lessor or insurer routing, service-network margin and patient-safety liability are unproved.
KSeF compulsion is not a separate software budget; unresolved exception value, security access and differentiation from ERP or accounting vendors are missing.
HVAC contractors already bundle logs and reminders, while addressable covered assets, technician capture behavior and per-asset software margin are unknown.
The UDT fee belongs to UDT, not the venture; no failure-delay rate or private preflight budget offsets installer and manufacturer bundling of this copyable pack.

This CBAM cockpit repeats the historical supplier-and-broker access problem, while the threshold concentrates buyers among enterprise incumbents and certificate liability does not prove software spend.

portfolio_balance_notes: The eight span verified-savings recovery, claims recovery, payment-dispute recovery, managed infrastructure uptime, receivables operations, industrial maintenance, regulated inspection dispatch and healthcare booking; no more than one selected structure depends on the same buyer or transaction.
Regulation is treated as a trigger or data source, never as proof of a product budget. Each selected candidate still needs a signed paid continuation tied to an observable result.

The portfolio favors non-prompt assets: outcome-labeled savings or recovery histories, integrations, service networks, route density, appointment inventory and repair playbooks. Mere rule libraries, reports and passports were not enough.
No candidate has complete bottom-up pricing, margins, reachable customer counts or a demonstrated founder wealth path; these are decisive research gaps, not favorable assumptions.

Historical overlap was admitted only where the paid event and operating mechanism changed materially: live PV rescue is an alternate and live machine-fault routing is selected; CBAM, DORA and generic tender repeats were rejected.
stop_condition: Stop research on any candidate when a named buyer with authority will not grant the required data and pay for the next live event, when the necessary channel or operating partner will not commit, or when conservative contribution economics and founder hours cannot support the stated wealth path. After one bounded decision-critical pass through the selected eight, stop the portfolio stage if none clears those conditions; do not turn alternates into an unbounded retry loop.
